en: Colored postcard view of a large medieval clock tower on a hill overlooking a city. The tower has a steep tiled roof, timbered upper structure, and a massive clock face with Roman numerals on a stone base. Trees frame the left side, and at the bottom right a person in early-20th-century clothing stands by a path and railing, looking out over the rooftops and distant hills. Printed text at the top identifies the location in German.
